changelog_from_0_1: Law is a 3-axis object plus shape: (quantity, transition, precondition, schema). The kappa pair forced this: same quantity, same transition, same schema — the precondition alone flips FALSIFIED to PROVED.
Every schema now carries a typed signature so the computer can reject category-stretching, not just display it.

Three candidate schemas added as v0.2 hypotheses: CLOSURE, COHERENCE, WELL_FOUNDEDNESS. Eight was the v0.1 hypothesis, not a constant of nature. Open research question: the smallest generating basis that classifies the corpus without semantic stretching.
Warrant gains SUPPORT (the measurement carrier) and world_revision. Two invalidation modes: support intact (quantity moves under known laws) vs support changed (re-derive, all bets off).
Instrument model is many-to-many: an instrument is a BUNDLE of claims on law cells, each with entitlement, settlement rule, and witness. 'A currency is a claim on a law' stays as the page copy.
Cells carry a counterlaw pointer: every proved conditional law names its falsified unrestricted sibling. The pair teaches more than either member.

Status vocabulary: PROVED, PROPERTY-TESTED, MODEL-CHECKED-FRAGMENT, EMPIRICAL, OPEN, NOT_APPLICABLE, FALSIFIED. Falsified-by-design rows must keep failing: a passing red row means the definition changed.
New evidence class: trvm_law_kernel.mjs — the grid compiled into a runtime's own falsifier, with two discoveries logged below.

discoveries.name: scheduler-safety gate
discoveries.finding: DUP-VAR/DUP-APP may fire under free scheduling only on GENUINELY stuck values (free-headed). The reference normal-order strategy hides this precondition; firing DUP-VAR on a bound-but-unsubbed variable can tie sub[x]=Var(a), sub[a]=Var(x) — a black hole normal order can never reach. A precondition the spec should state for any coordination-free scheduler.

changelog_from_0_2: TWO STRATA. Object laws constrain quantities inside a domain (the eight). Meta-laws constrain relationships between layers/compositions: EQUIVARIANCE (new, promoted on evidence), CLOSURE, COHERENCE, REFINEMENT, WELL_FOUNDEDNESS, PROGRESS/LIVENESS (candidate). CLOSURE/COHERENCE/WELL_FOUNDEDNESS moved from candidate-orbitals to the meta stratum — they were never awkward ninth orbitals; they live one level up.

EQUIVARIANCE earned its place by catching two real bugs in one review round: scalar kappa is not renaming-invariant at SCC ties (360/360 split over 720 relabelings of one graph — verified), and the kernel's v1 state digest collapsed binder connectivity (different programs digested identically — verified against the shipped code, fixed, regression L-EQV-1 added).

KAPPA IS NOW A PROFILE. kappa_S is defined per SCC support; topology emits {(support, size, kappa_S, cut witness)}; POLICY selects (largest / max-kappa / threshold / query-overlap); the warrant records both. The clean theorem C2-prime: for fixed SCC support S, adding an edge inside G[S] never decreases kappa_S — exhaustive n=4 (9,240 internal additions, 0 decreases) + argument. Slogan: Measurement is invariant. Selection is policy. Warrant authorizes.

WARRANT v3: freshness binds to what the derivation READ, not to a global epoch — {exact: [resource@version], predicates: [scope-query@version]}. The predicate scope handles the phantom-read problem kappa exposed (new edges from a node that did not exist when you read can grow the SCC without touching any old edge). Independently mirrored by Atomix's read-scope sealing.

EXECUTION PRIVILEGES. The operational meaning of an established law: a freedom the runtime may exercise. Confluence -> reorder/parallelize reduction; monotonicity/I-confluence -> coordination-free merge; locality -> concurrent disjoint transitions; idempotence -> retry/dedupe; conservation -> bounded transfer accounting; binding -> context-checked consumption; decay -> deterministic expiry; annihilation -> fail-closed refusal; derivation -> independent regeneration; equivariance -> placement/renaming freedom (node ids and worker placement cannot leak into semantics). A FALSIFIED law is executable too: it REMOVES an optimizer permission (unrestricted kappa-monotonicity is forbidden as a rewrite justification).

NAMING SPLIT adopted: STATE_APPLY (period COMMIT), ARTIFACT_COMMIT (//commit canonicalize-freeze), EFFECT_SETTLE (external finality). Three different irreversibility boundaries deserve three names in IR and films.

FOUR PLANES for TRVM: INTERACT (core rules, confluence) / COLLAPSE-OBSERVE (readback; DUP-VAR & DUP-APP live here per upstream IC's Collapsing extension and forge/random_order.py's pre-existing guard) / WORLD (ADMIT-APPLY, CALM & I-confluence, walls) / EFFECT (seal -> revalidate -> settle). Walls = where the proof of coordination-free admissibility ends.

FRAMING. Cells are metamorphic relations (Q, T, P, R); the table is a domain-specific periodic grammar for DISCOVERING metamorphic relations and compiling the held ones into runtime privileges and the falsified ones into removed permissions.

HONESTY EDITS. L-MONO-1 renamed substitution-store inflationarity (a monotone-state ingredient; the CALM-level claim about specification outcomes belongs to the world layer — cf. Complete CALM, arXiv 2602.09435, verified). L-DERIV-4 reclassified as a DOMAIN-EXCLUSION witness (affinity is definitional; the witness shows why the domain boundary exists). Kernel's scheduler gate credited to forge/random_order.py, which already enforced it.

changelog_from_0_3: SELF-CONSISTENCY. Round-3 review caught this record contradicting its own changelog: flagship_pair still held the superseded carrier-preserving theorem and the canonical warrant key still held the v2 shape while the changelog described v3. Both canonical keys are now replaced, the superseded forms moved to an explicit history key, and grid_check.mjs (GRID-CONSISTENCY-1) makes recurrence a build failure: a generated record may not contradict its own latest declared revision. This is REFINEMENT applied to the record itself.

ADEQUACY joins the meta-laws as Equivariance's dual: Equivariance = do not distinguish irrelevant differences (Q(phi x) = phi(Q x)); Adequacy = do not erase relevant differences (P(x)=P(y) => O(x)=O(y)). Genealogy: the film binder collision and the kappa scalar were both adequacy failures; kernel rows L-ADEQ-1 / L-EQV-1 now test the pair separately.

PROGRESS promoted from candidate to load-bearing, on kernel evidence: 150/600 random schedules blew the budget while completed runs never disagreed, and the L-PROG-1 battery shows four naive enumeration schedulers all failing the same six duplication-heavy terms at a 20k budget while the reference normal-order strategy finishes all 24 in at most 91 interactions. Confluence proves where you may arrive; Progress proves your scheduler can get you there. Privileges split: CONFLUENCE grants result-reordering; PROGRESS(strategy) grants scheduling under that strategy; both grant parallel free scheduling.

C4 now tests full structured equivariance Q(phi G) = phi(Q G) with supports mapped through the permutation (round 3 caught that the earlier test only reached the (size, kappa) quotient): 720/720 exhaustive on the tie witness + 200/200 random n=5. Witness-cut equivariance deferred pending a canonical cut-selection policy — selection is policy, again.

EVIDENCE-GRADE HASHES. All kernel evidence identities (state digests, sem ids, film frame ids) are now full untruncated SHA-256, including internal tree-hash compaction (a truncated inner node would undercut the outer commitment). Policy recorded: FastDigest64 may exist for tables/debugging but never flows into films, artifact ids, commitments, certificates, or receipts.

FILM v3. Frames now bind pre AND post canonical state ids and hash-chain (frame_id = H(prev | pre | rule | path | post)); films end with a terminal record {termination: NORMAL_FORM | BUDGET_EXHAUSTED, steps, last_frame}; replay verifies both states and recomputes the chain, refusing with typed reasons (revision-mismatch, post-state-mismatch, chain-mismatch).
changelog_from_0_4: RETRACTION. Round-3's L-PROG-1 moral — 'the strategy is the progress certificate' — was wrong twice over. The six scheduler failures were not slowness but FALSE QUIESCENCE: enumeration reported no redexes at steps 15/26/21/37/37/27 with almost no interactions consumed, and the reference driver, resumed from those states, burns a 2,000,000 budget in a sub-map knot. The witness stays red by design (L-FQ-AST-1, law:sched.free.ast-term@1). A red row must be DIAGNOSED before it is narrated.

REPRESENTATION, NOT PLANES. Restricting free choice to INTERACT-plane rules still knots 18/24 — plane mixing was never the seam; the body-carrying AST term representation was. Scheduling freedom is re-stated on floating-dup-heap-v1 (dups extruded to a heap, tree kept dup-free) and PROPERTY-TESTED there: 96/96 runs across 4 schedulers complete within 91 steps and agree with the reference NF (law:sched.free.float@1). Freedom is a property of RELATION+REPRESENTATION, and it now travels with a checkable SchedulerCertificate (law:sched.certificate@1) rather than as prose.

QUIESCENCE SHARPENED to pool-quiescence + READBACK PURITY: from quiescence the readback fires ZERO INTERACT-plane rules — only DUP-VAR collapse, exactly one per residual live dup (law:collapse.progress@1; 8 residual-collapse states surfaced in 84 fuzz states — the class exists off the vectors too). The AST relation's false quiescence violated exactly this purity: its readback fired INTERACT and diverged.

THE HARNESS CAUGHT ITS BUILDER TWICE IN ONE DAY: (a) enumeration initially missed App redexes inside heap-dup values — NF batteries flagged it; totality over the live pool restored; (b) DEAD heap dups could fire on shared live values and double-consume affinity — a fuzz term diverged (lambda a.b vs lambda a.a); enumeration now ranges over LIVE ids only. 'Garbage must not compute' is an affinity theorem on this representation, not an optimization. Both are negative results that DESIGNED the engine; both would have shipped silently without the falsifier suite.

FILM v3.1 closes round-3's terminal hole: the terminal (termination, steps, last frame, final state, normal-form or budget+remaining-work witness, plane profile) is bound into film_id, frames carry plane + typed locus (t:/d:/v:), and replay RE-DERIVES the terminal instead of trusting it — a forged normal_form with an honestly recomputed film_id is still refused (false-normal-form). 16 typed refusals; frame.i declared non-authoritative (law:film.evidence-chain@4).

PLANES made first-class and MEASURED: INTERACT/COLLAPSE partition the rules (law:plane.rule-partition@1); phased composition is an interleaved FIXPOINT, max alternation depth 4 observed, because collapse re-enables interact (law:plane.separation.fixpoint@1). Interaction counts on the certified relation are schedule-invariant AND equal the spec's embedded counts — the JS normal-order conformance driver itself agrees with the spec only 18/24 (law:deriv.count-invariance.float@1).

LAW REGISTRY replaces prose as the citation authority: every law carries id@revision, a canonical flag, and supersession lineage; grid_check v2 (law:grid.consistency@2) validates the registry and resolves every 'law:' citation across kernel, kappa witnesses, grid, scheduler certificate, and ledgers — an unknown or silently-stale reference is a build failure. The round-3 grep blacklist survives only as a supplementary tripwire.

changelog_from_0_5: AUTHORITY OUTRAN EVIDENCE, TWICE — and both channels are now re-derivation. External audit forged all 10 single-field mutations of the round-4 SchedulerCertificate (representation, criterion, strategy, budget, evidence inflated to 999,999 runs, claims and law refs erased, corpus id, ALL exhibits erased, profile broadened with a fake rule) past checkSchedulerCertificate v1, and a hollow zero-exhibit certificate ALSO passed grid_check: an assurance-COMPOSITION bug — fragment verifiers whose union did not verify the substantive claim. All verified here by probe before the fix (law:sched.certificate@2 supersedes the superseded @1).

EXHIBIT != EVIDENCE BASIS. Six films were witnesses for a 96-run claim; nothing re-derived the 96. SchedulerCertificate v2 carries a RUN MANIFEST — one receipt per run (term, scheduler, seed, steps, interactions, termination, state/nf/film ids, readback counts) — and the checker RE-EXECUTES every receipt deterministically; aggregates are recomputed by arithmetic; claims are verified semantically; law refs must be JUSTIFIED by verified claims. Every field is Derived, Committed, or Informational (law:cert.field-discipline@1); a laundered forgery (commitment honestly recomputed) must survive the semantic re-derivations — L-CERT-2 shows 15/15 do not, plus the hollow zero-receipt certificate.

FILMS MUST WITNESS THE RELATION. Probes built digest-consistent, honestly-committed films firing DEAD heap loci — mechanically firable, outside the live relation — and v0.5 replay accepted them (227 adversarial runs). Replay now requires each frame's rule to be in the declared rule pool and its locus ENABLED in the live enumeration under that pool (plane-not-permitted, illegal-transition; 18 typed refusals; law:film.evidence-chain@5 supersedes the superseded @4). Digest consistency binds WHICH states were visited, not WHETHER the transitions were legal.

A DIAGNOSIS RETRACTED, SYMMETRICALLY. Round 4 attributed the lambda a.b fuzz divergence to dead-dup 'affinity double-consumption'. 400+ dead-firing probe runs — including an exact replication of the pre-fix fuzz stream — produced ZERO NF divergence: the corruption is attributable to the READBACK hole (Bug B); dead enumeration's confirmed harms are illegal-relation transitions and quiescence distortion. The live-only relation stands; its round-4 evidence story is corrected in kernel_evidence.round_4. The round-4 discipline — a red row must be diagnosed before it is narrated — applied to the narrator's own bug story.

DIVISION OF VERIFICATION, BY CONSTRUCTION. grid_check v2.1 recomputes the engine-free half (commitments, aggregate arithmetic, completeness, and representation/profile/refs/claims/exhibits against this record's own machine-readable scheduler_certificate section); the kernel checker re-executes the engine half (every receipt, every claim, every exhibit frame). No certificate field is covered by zero re-derivations. The builder itself became reproducible again the same way: the lost v0.4 source was recovered by SPLITTING the verified v0.5 build into its constituent blocks and proving the split by byte-identical reassembly.
changelog_from_0_6: THE IDENTITY QUESTION, ANSWERED AGAINST US AND CLOSED. External audit constructed the witness this record had named-but-not-built: floatDigest varies under heap-id permutation on behaviorally identical states (18b4e47b... vs 6bca1878...). Reproduced byte-for-byte, extended (dead entries perturb it too), and resolved by a SPLIT, not a weakening: execStateId stays allocation-sensitive and replay-grade (law:state.exec-identity@1); semStateId folds the LIVE heap in discovery order and quotients ids, dead content, allocation order, alpha, and labels (law:state.semantic-quotient@1). One digest is never forced to mean two things.

THE IC32 BRIDGE IS EXECUTABLE TODAY. An adversarial DESCENDING allocator — chosen because a monotone perturbation is invisible to sorted folds — runs every vector in lockstep with the standard one: per-step semantic chains equal 24/24, NFs reference-equal, counts equal. SEMANTIC FILMS (canonical loci, semantic pre/post, TRVM-SEMFILM-v1 commitment) replay across allocators 24/24; execution films are refused 17/24 and bit-identical 7/24. refinement_receipt.json records the asymmetry (law:refine.alloc-portability@1); grid_check recomputes its arithmetic and commitment engine-free.

STARVATION INSIDE THE CERTIFICATE. starve_dups and starve_apps join the battery — 144 receipts, six committed scheduler names, max steps unchanged at 91 (law:sched.adversarial.float@1). Fairness evidence travels in the same receipts as freedom evidence.

THE EXECUTABLE MAY NOT DISAGREE WITH THE ARTIFACT. The audit caught v0.6 source printing a v0.5 banner one round after evidence-binding. KERNEL_VERSION is a constant; header, banner, and certificate generator must agree (L-ID-1, REGRESSION-LOCKED, law:kernel.identity@1), and grid_check locks grid.version to the kernel source.

V1.0.0 DECLARED, WITH ITS SCOPE STATED. The calculus layer's law set is closed over its own claims (see v1_criteria); WORLD/EFFECT, sigma, CP5-CP7, and Warrant v3 with the shared support/footprint concept are the named next layers. The one criterion declared NOT met by design: a second implementation — the interface for it is what this round built.
changelog_from_1_0_0: THE TERMINAL CONTRACT, FALSIFIED AND CLOSED AS A LAW. Round-6B audit: a zero-frame BUDGET_EXHAUSTED semantic film over an enabled state replayed ok under TRVM-SEMFILM-v1, and budget/remaining_work were outside the commitment entirely (budget_mutation_preserves_id: true). The third replay implementation was not entitled to inherit the correctness of the first two — recorded twice now, and the law exists so ic32 (the fourth) inherits the OBLIGATION instead.

changelog_from_1_0_1: THE WARRANT BECAME EXECUTABLE, IN ITS OWN ARTIFACT. Warrant v3 had been a grid spec since round 3; trvm_world.mjs v0.1.0 implements it whole: WorldRecord (monotone vclock, append-only log, reified scope queries), tracked derivation views, warrant commitment under TRVM-WARRANT-v3 with round-5 field discipline, freshness as a generalized verifying trace, and JAILED replay where an undeclared read refuses — the authority-must-not-outrun-evidence law applied to reads (law:warrant.footprint-soundness@1). The calculus kernel is FROZEN at v1.0.1, per the closure audit's own recommendation.

THE PHANTOM IS NO LONGER A SENTENCE IN A SPEC. The kappa phantom-read case — a member joining the measured structure without touching any read resource — is CONSTRUCTED: true component size 3, warranted value 2, unguarded warrant 'fresh'. Kept red by construction. The guard is a reified predicate scope whose digest lives in the footprint; the same phantom classifies scope_dirty under it (law:warrant.phantom-scope@1).

STALENESS IS A CLASSIFICATION WITH WITNESSES, AND ONE CLASS IS CHEAP. support_changed / scope_dirty / support_intact each carry a complete verdict witness (film.terminal-witness applied to verdicts); support_intact performs EARLY CUTOFF — jailed re-derivation reproducing the value refreshes the footprint and reseals instead of discarding (law:warrant.invalidation-trichotomy@1).

ONE EVIDENCE LANGUAGE. The round-5 requirement — certificate and warrant share a support/footprint concept — is discharged executably: the shipped 144-receipt SchedulerCertificate wraps as a Warrant v3 whose single exact read is the corpus resource; certificate freshness IS warrant freshness (law:footprint.shared@1).

IDENTITY BECAME A MAP. Two executables now ship; grid.version is the record's own lineage and artifact_versions locks each executable's declared constant (kernel.identity@2 supersedes @1; grid_check v2.5 parses both constants from source).
changelog_from_1_1_0: COMPOSITION WITHOUT LAUNDERING. A warrant cites a warrant only through its PUBLICATION, and the battery constructs what publication-only citation costs: the citee goes phantom-stale, its publication never moves, and the naive composite is 'fresh' while transitively wrong — the phantom, one level up, kept red. The repair reifies freshness itself as a scope (warrant-fresh:<name> = the citee's footprint re-evaluated), so one ground movement dirties every guarded citer through chains and diamonds without any publication write (law:warrant.composition@1).

THE JAIL IS THE ABSTRACTION BOUNDARY. Composite replay reads publications and freshness scopes — never citee internals; a replayer reaching inside refuses undeclared-read, and a derivation that throws without a jail violation refuses derivation-threw (ninth refusal). Composites provably use only published values.

SIGMA T4, EXECUTABLE. The frame rule as a property test: footprint membership + scope influence PREDICT the freshness verdict on 120/120 random writes — writes outside a warrant's evidence cannot change its verdict (law:warrant.frame@1). The sigma_profile section records the T1/T2/T4 world-layer instantiations.
changelog_from_1_2_0: STATE CANNOT CHANGE WITHOUT AN IDENTITY TRANSITION. The audit's AUDIT-WORLD-ALIAS falsified the substrate: the store held JS values by reference, so world.read(r).value.push(2) mutated the world with no put and no version movement — and the two verifiers DISAGREED (freshness: fresh; jailed replay: value-mismatch). Closed as law:world.write-mediated@1: a canonical resource-value domain, store-owned bytes under TRVM-VALUE-v1 content hashes, fresh parses on every read, both alias directions dead at the boundary — same version implies same canonical value. The witness is reproduced and kept.

DELETED IS NOT NEVER-EXISTED. Deletions are tombstones carrying the deletion version; the version layer no longer collapses the two histories, and the lifecycle (absent -> put -> update -> delete -> recreate) is a battery.

FRESH => REPLAY-COHERENT, AS ITS OWN LAW. The implication the witness falsified is now law:warrant.fresh-replay-coherence@1, property-tested over 200 random histories with adversarial alias attempts: every fresh verdict replays ok, and the per-history version=>hash invariant holds with the store cross-checked against its own log.

AN AUDIT CAUGHT A VACUOUS ASSERTION. L-WORLD-1's first version contained `... || true` — incapable of failing, in the battery introducing the monotonicity law. Removed, battery strengthened (latest-read on all six live resources, tombstone lifecycle, version=>hash), and confessed in the evidence line rather than silently fixed.

THE LAYERS' LESSONS RHYME, AND THE RECORD SAYS SO. Round 5: authority must not outrun evidence. Round 6: identity must know what it identifies. Round 8.1: evidence cannot outrun the state identity of the world it describes — the world-layer analog of the execution-vs-semantic split, recorded in world.round_8_1_witness.
changelog_from_1_3_0: SUPPORT IS DERIVED, NOT DECLARED INTO AUTHORITY. The audit forged a warrant's support to [] with an honest reseal: replay accepted it, the next support movement classified support_intact instead of support_changed, refreshWarrant preserved the forgery, and the receipt version passed grid_check — authority outran evidence again, one layer up. Closed as law:warrant.support-soundness@1: canonical support at seal, dual-property enforcement (subset AND exact equality with the derivation's own output) in BOTH replayers, truth-restoring refresh, and the receipt's committed world_spec + --check-receipt engine half. The locked regression is the audit's exact chain.

THE CLASSIFICATION LIMIT IS STATED, NOT HIDDEN. freshness() cannot see a support forgery without running the engine — the record says so; the gates that matter (replay, refresh, receipt check) all re-derive.

ONE DISCIPLINE ACROSS WARRANT KINDS. replayComposite had neither support check; it now runs both, and the pruned-publication forgery dies twice over (structurally, then — when made fully consistent — at the jail).
changelog_from_1_4_0: MAINTENANCE EXISTS, AND ITS FALSIFIERS CAME FIRST. The audit's seven obligations were implemented as batteries before the engine was trusted: dependency order is real (the wrong-order counterfactual carries the wrong value and is detectably non-fresh — kept red), diamonds re-derive the shared citee once with identical receipts across identical runs, converged passes are receipted no-ops, forged input is quarantined at register() and in-pass (never repaired or republished), cycles refuse the whole pass by Kahn-leftover proof, and a mid-pass failure discards the world fork — nothing half-advanced (laws maintenance.pass/quarantine/atomicity/receipt/acyclicity @1).

THE RECEIPT PROVES THE PASS. before/after publication maps and ordered steps are committed under TRVM-MAINTPASS-v1, and grid_check v2.9 reconstructs after from before+steps by arithmetic — the round-5 danger zone the audit flagged, closed on arrival rather than after.

FORK-AND-APPLY REQUIRED AN HONEST REFACTOR. Scope queries now read through an interface instead of captured world references, making World.fork() total — the atomicity law's enabling condition, and a cleaner query contract besides.
changelog_from_1_5_0: COMPUTATION INSIDE A TRANSACTION CANNOT ESCAPE ITS AUTHORITY BOUNDARY. The audit's witness retained the real World in a measureFn, wrote it mid-pass, and threw: the 'aborted' pass had moved the authoritative vclock, and the receipt — sampling the clock in the catch handler — reported the escaped transition's RESULT as its own pre-state. Closed as law:maintenance.capability-confinement@1: the root World locks for the pass (writes refuse world-write-during-maintenance), apply goes through a per-lock commit capability, finally releases on every exit path, and the entry clock is captured before any adversarial code runs. Fork-and-apply is an isolation boundary now, not a convention.

THE RHYME EXTENDS ONE MORE LAYER, in the audit's own words: 8.1 — state cannot change without World identity changing; 8.2 — semantic support cannot be asserted without derivational evidence; 9.1 — computation inside a transaction cannot escape the transaction's authority. Each is the same law wearing the next layer's clothes.

SCOPE STATED, NOT SMUGGLED: register/addGround derive against the live world by design and are not transactional; worker-domain isolation for derivations (the audit's stronger option) is declared as the v-next, aligned with what portable/ic32 derivations need anyway.
changelog_from_1_6_0: THE MASTER KEY WAS HANGING ON THE OBJECT — the audit named the risk before finding it, and it was real twice over: world._lockKey was public (a retained closure stole it and committed THROUGH the lock, leaking mid-pass with no abort), and the internals (res/log/queries/vclock) were public fields open to guard-free raw mutation. Closed at the structure, not the convention: true private fields for all state, a crypto-random key, copying read surfaces, and frozen prototype + instances — a retained reference now carries no authority the transaction did not hand it (law:maintenance.capability-confinement@1, evidence amended with the arc).

OPTION 1'S OUTER LIMIT IS NOW ACTUALLY REACHED, and the record says where it sits: same-realm JavaScript with sealed objects. What remains beyond it — realm/worker isolation for derivations — stays the declared v-next, aligned with portable/ic32 execution.
changelog_from_1_7_0: THE APPLY BOUNDARY LEARNED TO CONFESS. A mid-apply fault previously left the world half-applied, skipped the receipt, and propagated raw. Now staged publications pre-validate before the first real write (organic tears unreachable), injected tears are receipted truthfully with the applied prefix and the REAL post-tear clocks, grid_check verifies torn receipts prefix-wise, and the next pass provably repairs and converges. Self-found on the surface previously declared open; provisional pending the external round-9D text.

entries.statement: the rule set partitions into INTERACT {APP-LAM, APP-SUP, APP-ERA, DUP-LAM, DUP-SUP=, DUP-SUP!, DUP-ERA} and COLLAPSE {DUP-VAR, DUP-APP}; every fired frame carries its plane and replay refuses plane-mismatch

entries.statement: phased INTERACT-then-COLLAPSE composes only as an INTERLEAVED FIXPOINT: COLLAPSE can re-enable INTERACT (copying a stuck application exposes new APP redexes) — it is not a two-phase pipeline

entries.statement: READBACK PURITY + BOUNDEDNESS: from pool-quiescence the readback fires ZERO INTERACT-plane rules — only DUP-VAR collapse, exactly one per residual live dup

The AST relation's false quiescence violated exactly this purity: its readback fired INTERACT and diverged.

entries.statement: films are hash-chained frames (frame_id = H(prev|pre|rule|path|post)); replay refuses 5 typed tamper classes — TERMINAL UNBOUND (round-4 hole: replay never checked film.terminal and there was no film_id)

Honest BUDGET_EXHAUSTED films replay ok with the remaining-work witness verified; frame.i mutation accepted as declared non-authoritative metadata. Round-5 audit (superseded): replay accepted digest-consistent, honestly-committed films firing DEAD heap loci — 227 adversarial prefer-dead runs — transitions mechanically firable but outside the live relation.

entries.evidence: Kernel row L-ADEQ-2: 269 distinct-NF pairs this round, 0 digest collisions.

entries.statement: scheduling-freedom claims travel as a portable SchedulerCertificate: corpus-hash-bound, plane-profiled, with replayable exhibit films; an independent checker verifies or refuses

Round-5 audit (superseded): 10/10 single-field forgeries (representation, criterion, strategy, budget, evidence inflation to 999,999 runs, claims/law-refs erased, corpus id, ALL exhibits erased, profile broadened with a fake rule) plus a hollow zero-exhibit certificate were ACCEPTED — the checker re-derived only the corpus hash and replayed only what it was handed; the hollow certificate also passed grid_check (assurance-composition hole).

entries.statement: the generated record may not contradict its own latest declared revision — enforced by grep blacklist over known-stale phrases (v1 checker)

entries.statement: REGISTRY-DRIVEN consistency: every 'law:' citation in every artifact resolves against this registry; canonical uniqueness per id; supersession lineage closed; a citation of a non-canonical entry outside superseded/history context fails the build
